headline: Executive order directing federal efforts to update how flu vaccines are made in the United States, citing public health and national security.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Trump in September 2019, deals with modernizing flu vaccines in the United States. Based on its title, it directs the federal government to work on improving flu vaccines and how they are produced. It presents this as a matter of both public health and national security. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps, agencies, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would likely be the ones directed to carry out the order's flu vaccine goals.
Their work could be shaped by federal efforts to change how flu vaccines are developed and produced.
The order's stated goal is to improve the flu vaccines available to the public over time.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 19, 2019; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
